title: Daily panel manifest (data_collection/panel/{trading_day}/manifest.json, data_daily_panel_manifest.v1)
description: The sidecar every daily panel publish writes AFTER its parquet (alpha-engine-config-I10791 / P-25). It binds the parquet to its contract version and content hash, so a consumer can refuse a panel it cannot account for (wrong schema version, wrong day, hash mismatch) instead of reading whatever bytes are at the key, and so the phase-3 acceptance clause `data.phase3.daily_panel_adopted` can grade the publish without reading the parquet. Written last: a manifest with no parquet behind it, or a parquet with no manifest, is an incomplete publish, never a partial success. ONE DEFINITION of keys and versions: contracts/daily_panel.py. PRODUCER TEST: tests/test_daily_panel_contract.py.

panel_schema_version.description: The row contract the parquet conforms to (daily_panel.schema.json).

trading_day.description: The session the panel ends on; also the {trading_day} in both keys.

panel_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact parquet bytes written to panel_key.

columns.description: The parquet's columns in order; must equal contracts/daily_panel.py::PANEL_COLUMNS.

symbol_count.description: Distinct tickers anywhere in the window.

symbols_on_trading_day.description: Distinct tickers with a row ON trading_day. A panel with none is refused before publish.

session_count.description: Distinct sessions in the window: the panel's DEPTH, which a consumer compares with the depth its feature layer needs.

lookback_calendar_days.description: The window (trading_day - lookback, trading_day] the compile requested.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the publish completed. Provenance: differs on every re-production of the same panel.

code_sha.description: Commit of the producer code that compiled the panel ('unknown' only when no git context exists, which the producer records rather than hides).
